GeoNames geographical data

Source: GeoNames, https://www.geonames.org/
Downloads: https://download.geonames.org/export/dump/
Source files: countryInfo.txt, admin1CodesASCII.txt, cities15000.zip,
alternateNamesV2.zip
Snapshot downloaded: 2026-11-20
License: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
License terms: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Legal code: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode

PND transforms this data into country records and country-grouped city JSON,
retains selected geographic fields, sorts cities by population, and compresses
each country's city list. This is a major-city/capital snapshot and does not
cover every settlement. Source hashes are recorded in
internal/geography/data/manifest.json. No endorsement by GeoNames is implied.

English and Chinese alternate names are selected by language and preference
flags. Chinese fallback names are converted with OpenCC s2twp at build time.
Records without supported Chinese names retain their English/source names.
Search aliases and translated administrative-area names are included.

GeoNames supplies the data as is, without warranties of accuracy, timeliness,
or completeness. PND's MIT source-code license does not replace the dataset's
CC BY 4.0 terms.
